message.reasoning: We need to answer. The question: "A ticket opened Friday evening shows as breached by Saturday morning, which cannot be within our stated hours." They are complaining that ticket breached outside business hours. We have policy excerpts about response-time metrics: default counts every hour including nights, weekends, holidays. Business-hours version can be configured. So answer: explain that default counts all hours; if they want to exclude, configure business hours. So respond accordingly.

function.arguments: {"message":"Hi! I’m sorry you’re seeing a breach outside of your business hours. By default, the response‑time metric counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered – that includes nights, weekends and holidays. If you’d like the metric to ignore time outside your normal hours, you can set up business hours in Settings → Reporting → Business hours and switch the dashboard to “business hours” mode. That will exclude those periods entirely from the calculation. Let me know if you’d like help setting that up!"}

arguments.message: Hi! I’m sorry you’re seeing a breach outside of your business hours. By default, the response‑time metric counts every hour a ticket sits unanswered – that includes nights, weekends and holidays. If you’d like the metric to ignore time outside your normal hours, you can set up business hours in Settings → Reporting → Business hours and switch the dashboard to “business hours” mode. That will exclude those periods entirely from the calculation. Let me know if you’d like help setting that up!
